body.x: Bracketron, unveils its powerful new line of suction mounts that are ideal for in-vehicle use and offer secure and convenient viewing of mobile devices for hands-free applications.
The Mi-T Grip Dash Mount’s patented Temporbond technology allows it to adhere to any hard surface in your car, boat or home for easy viewing and accessibility.

The Universal Tablet Window Mount provides a sturdy, low-profile way to secure an iPad mini or tablet to your windshield for safe, hands-free navigation. These heavy duty mounts come with a one-year warranty and are a simple-to-use and effective solution for your mounting needs.

“Our latest line of accessories provides an ideal alternative for consumers who rely on their mobile devices for GPS and navigation,” said Christian Johnson, Vice President of Marketing at Bracketron. “Their non-intrusive designs deliver the security consumers have come to expect from Bracketron, while allowing safe and convenient access to people on the move.”
